definitions: An exclamation of shock or dismay when something inappropriate, unexpected, or unpleasant occurs in one's immediate vicinity or personal space.
Used to express a feeling of violation or discomfort when witnessing something offensive or out of place, especially when one is trying to enjoy a peaceful moment or meal.
examples: They started arguing loudly, right in front of my salad!
I can't believe they're doing that right in front of my salad.
He spilled his drink all over the table, right in front of my salad.
lemma: right in front of my salad
source: right in front of my salad
